# Hotel Chandreshwar

> Hotel Chandreshwar is a budget hotel in Chandreshwar Nagar, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India, offering AC and Non-AC double-bed rooms with attached bathrooms, hot water and direct booking by phone or WhatsApp.

Hotel Chandreshwar has 10 double-bed rooms in total: 3 AC rooms and 7 Non-AC rooms, each for double occupancy (max 2 guests) with an attached bathroom, hot water and no online payment required — bookings are confirmed directly with the hotel by phone or WhatsApp.

Location: Near Durga Mandir, Dayanand Ashram Road, Chandreshwar Nagar, Rishikesh, Dehradun, Uttarakhand – 249201, India. About 800 m from Triveni Ghat and the main bus stand, and about 2 km from Yog Nagari Rishikesh Railway Station.

Contact: +91 94107 07392 (phone/WhatsApp), chandreshwarhotel2008@gmail.com.
